skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Basic Concepts of Anticipatory Governance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of anticipatory governance and forecasting in economic and social contexts.
Develop skills to use modern forecasting tools to identify and analyze future trends, aiding strategic decision-making.
Apply anticipatory governance methods to build scenarios and develop flexible strategic plans for organizations.
Analyze factors affecting anticipatory governance processes and develop effective management solutions.
Improve autonomous capabilities, critical thinking, and responsibility in planning and managing organizational changes.
